spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap
spot_price_manipulated.checkpoint: before validatePrice and subsequent swap/liquidity action

reserve_drain_occurred.meaning: liquidity manager operations or buybacks drained protocol-owned reserves

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked to check the price for a subsequent swap or liquidity action (validate_price_called).
The TWAP guard is intended to reject a transiently manipulated spot price as outside slippage limits (intent_twap_guard).

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric slippage limits, reserve amounts, or magnitudes for the drain; the drain is stated only as a potential qualitative outcome, so the impact is encoded as a grounded Boolean occurrence rather than a quantified reserve change.
Whether the manipulated swap actually executes is conditional (can/may), not observed; the drain is potential.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the reserve_drain impact; guard_passes, swaps_at_manipulated_prices and economic_loss are handled in separate passes.
The drain is represented as a Boolean occurrence because the report supplies no amounts, percentages, or units.
